The '''Miner's Yard''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].

==History==
With [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] resource numbers plummeting daily, it was up to the local [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to branch out and collect resources to replenish high demands. To solve this problem, they targeted [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]] in the area.
